contexts.text: Avarice is a cupidity in the highest degree earthly. AC 4751:2. AC 10407:4.
The Most Ancient Church... regarded all earthly, worldly, and corporeal things... as dead.
(The Jews) wanted nothing but earthly things. AC 4459:end.
They obliterate truths by earthly loves.
These are the earthly things with which the Word itself... is obstructed.
Has immersed himself... even in what is earthly.
The Earthly, in which man now is, does not apprehend exalted things, and does not want to apprehend them.
The old man is in the affections of worldly and earthly things...
From early childhood to youth, man receives only earthly, corporeal, and worldly things...
The affection of gain is an earthly affection.

If the internal man looks... to earthly things... he cannot look upwards; for earthly things completely absorb and suffocate. The reason is, that the Angels cannot be with man in earthly things... Thus earthly things are everything to him; and when earthly things are everything to him, he believes himself to be wiser than all others... Therefore man must be either in an earthly affection, or in a heavenly one...
In (Mercury) they care nothing for earthly and corporeal things... AC 6811. AC 7070. AC 7071:end.
The Spirits of our Earth... care for material, worldly, corporeal, and earthly things.
At first, human minds apprehend nothing but earthly and worldly things... They who have earthly and worldly things as an end... are averse to spiritual ones.
The love of earthly things is as it were (of the colour) green.
